description: The **Treasurer** manages GNGRLL's finances: maintaining the bank and PayPal/online balances, tracking outstanding invoices and obligations, and delivering a financial/treasury update at each board meeting (bank & online balances, P&L/budget notes). Recurring obligations include paying the Little League charter & insurance fees each fall (~$1,300, authorized up to $2,000), setting registration fees, and supporting equipment/uniform spending motions. During the postseason the Treasurer leads tournament fundraising and family disbursements (per diem, hotel, and mileage reimbursements) and manages donation buckets and donor accounts.

calendar.title: Financial / Treasury update at board meeting
calendar.description: Present bank and PayPal/online balances, outstanding invoices/obligations, and P&L/budget notes at the board meeting; recurring at each meeting throughout the year.

calendar.title: Pay Little League charter & insurance fees (annual renewal)
calendar.description: Authorize and pay the annual LL charter & insurance renewal (Nov-Dec, ~$1,300; authorized up to $2,000 in recent years).

calendar.title: Registration fees set for coming season
calendar.description: Confirm registration fee schedule with the board (e.g. Juniors $150, Majors/AAA $140, AA $110, A/CP/TB $80, Sandlot add-on $20) ahead of the 1/1 registration open date.

calendar.title: Sponsorship / fundraising drive kickoff
calendar.description: Launch sponsorship letters, banners, plaques, and thank-yous; set team sponsorship level ($375-$475) and manage donor tiers (banner logo $200+, dye-sub jersey $500+, signed jersey $1,000+).

calendar.title: Tournament fundraising launch
calendar.description: Begin fundraising for advancing All-Star teams (hotels, mileage, uniforms, meals); set fundraising goal (e.g. $25,000 for Regionals) and coordinate buckets/GoFundMe/business donations.

calendar.title: Donation bucket collection run
calendar.description: Check the mailbox and donation buckets at partner businesses (B&R Dairy, Birchwood, Two Mums, Brickyard Hollow, etc.) and deposit proceeds.

calendar.title: Post-tournament family disbursement
calendar.description: Disburse hotel, per diem, and gas reimbursements to tournament families per policy (per diem $50/day/family, rooms $200/day, mileage at federal charity rate; receipts per applicable year's rule).

calendar.title: Vote on tournament family stipend
calendar.description: Bring the tournament family stipend (e.g. 14 families) to the board for a spending motion and vote.

tasks.title: Prepare monthly treasury report for board meeting
tasks.description: Compile current bank and PayPal/online balances, outstanding invoices/obligations, and P&L/budget notes to present at each board meeting.

tasks.title: Pay Little League charter & insurance renewal
tasks.description: Process the annual LL charter & insurance payment (Nov-Dec, ~$1,300; up to authorized cap of $2,000).

tasks.title: Reconcile registration revenue after open date
tasks.description: Track registration fee receipts by division against the approved fee schedule after registration opens 1/1; flag earmarked funds (e.g. AAA+ increase for field repairs).

tasks.title: Track sponsorship payments and donor management
tasks.description: Record sponsorship payments, manage donor tiers, and coordinate thank-you fulfillment (banners, plaques, signed/dye-sub jerseys); maintain donor records (Bloomerang subscription ~$1,400/yr).

tasks.title: Budget pre-season equipment and uniform spending
tasks.description: Support equipment and uniform spending motions (e.g. up to $5,000 equipment, uniforms up to $18,000) and ensure approved caps are tracked against actuals.

tasks.title: Establish tournament fundraising plan and goal
tasks.description: Set the tournament/World Series fundraising goal and disbursement/per-diem plan (buckets, GoFundMe, business donations); confirm receipt and per-diem rules for the current cycle.

tasks.title: Collect donation buckets and check mailbox
tasks.description: Empty donation buckets at partner businesses and check the league mailbox; log and deposit fundraising proceeds.

tasks.title: Disburse tournament family reimbursements
tasks.description: Pay out hotel, per diem, and gas reimbursements to advancing tournament families per the approved stipend and receipt policy.
